entries.mem0ai/mem0: This universal memory layer provides multi-level storage for user, session, and agent states using temporal reasoning and multi-signal retrieval. As an official Hermes Agent provider, it is available as a managed cloud service or an Apache-2.0 self-hosted server.
entries.volcengine/OpenViking: OpenViking organizes context as a virtual filesystem using viking:// URIs and a three-tier loading system to reduce token consumption. This official provider demonstrates significant task-completion gains and provides observable retrieval trajectories for debugging context paths.
entries.garrytan/gbrain: This opinionated agent brain features a self-wiring knowledge graph with typed edges to provide synthesized answers with citations and gap analysis. It is designed for multi-user team environments through the use of scoped access controls.
entries.supermemoryai/supermemory: Supermemory is an official provider that utilizes a custom vector graph engine to sustain sub-300ms recall at scales exceeding 100B tokens per month. It features automated fact extraction, byte-level deduplication for prompt-cache discounts, and native connectors for platforms like Google Drive and GitHub.
entries.vectorize-io/hindsight: Hindsight implements long-term retain, recall, and reflect workflows to create agent memory that learns over time. It supports over 25 LLM providers and is deployable via Docker, Kubernetes, or dedicated Python and Node.js clients.
entries.plastic-labs/honcho: This library enables reasoning-first memory by extracting conclusions from conversations and events rather than just raw logs. It serves as the upstream foundation for Hermes-specific wrappers and supports hybrid search across managed or self-hosted environments.
entries.campfirein/byterover-cli: ByteRover treats memory as a git repository, offering version control features like branching and merging over a plain markdown context tree. It achieves sub-100ms performance through a 5-tier retrieval system and includes an interactive TUI powered by React/Ink.
entries.mnemosyne-oss/mnemosyne: Mnemosyne is a zero-dependency memory system that uses a single SQLite database to achieve sub-millisecond performance for Hermes Agents. It features episodic compression to ensure sub-linear storage growth and supports integrations with MCP and OpenWebUI.
entries.ClaudioDrews/memory-os: This seven-layer memory system utilizes local infrastructure like Qdrant and Redis to manage persistent vector search and structured facts. It employs a Ground Truth hierarchy to ensure agents prioritize specific injected context during execution.
entries.greyhaven-ai/autocontext: Autocontext is a recursive self-improving harness that generates filesystem-first artifacts such as traces and playbooks to assist with complex tasks. It features outcome-gated context promotion and ablation-backed attribution to refine agent performance.
entries.stephenschoettler/hermes-lcm: This plugin provides lossless context management by storing messages in a SQLite-backed DAG that prevents data loss. It builds depth-aware summary nodes and provides specialized tools for agents to search and expand compacted hierarchical material.
entries.elkimek/honcho-self-hosted: This project provides a self-hosted backend for Honcho, enabling private cross-session persistence for Hermes Agents. It includes automated setup scripts for Docker, PostgreSQL, and Redis, and is compatible with any OpenAI-style LLM provider.
entries.Signet-AI/signetai: Signet-AI provides a local-first identity and memory layer that enables portable state across Hermes Agent and other clients like Claude Code. It achieves a 97.6% LongMemEval answer accuracy and supports data imports from Obsidian, Discord, and GitHub.
entries.plur-ai/plur: This shared memory layer uses an open engram YAML format to store memories locally as human-readable files. It integrates with MCP tools and utilizes hybrid retrieval combining BM25 with local embedders for multi-agent systems.
entries.yoloshii/ClawMem: ClawMem is an on-device context engine that operates locally without cloud dependencies or API keys. It employs hybrid retrieval, including vector search and BM25, and integrates via MCP, plugins, and Claude Code hooks.
entries.EfficientContext/ContextPilot: This project optimizes long-context LLM inference through block reordering and deduplication to enhance prefix reuse. It offers native plugin support for Hermes Agent, reducing prefill latency by 1.5–3× and saving up to 36% in token usage.
entries.Sibyl-Labs/Sibyl-Memory: Sibyl-Memory is a file-based long-term memory system that uses SQLite with FTS5 search instead of vector databases or embeddings. It features a five-package plugin family, including a dedicated Hermes adapter and a LangGraph BaseStore.
entries.yantrikos/yantrikdb-hermes-plugin: This self-maintaining plugin provides explainable retrieval by attaching a 'why_retrieved' tag to every recalled memory. It features a self-directing loop to resolve knowledge gaps and supports owner-scoping for multi-user environments.
entries.yepyhun/Brainstack: Brainstack serves as a memory kernel stack that integrates Hindsight, Graphiti, and MemPalace into a single owner. It manages state and retrieval using SQLite, Kuzu, and Chroma to deliver purpose-built evidence packets to the agent.
entries.amanning3390/flowstate-qmd: This anticipatory memory system prefetches context by monitoring agent session logs and storing data locally via SQLite-vec. It functions as an MCP-native server with automated configuration for major coding agent clients.
entries.ccf/agentcairn: AgentCairn provides cross-project memory for coding agents by using an Obsidian vault as the primary source of truth. It stores memories as inspectable Markdown files and utilizes DuckDB as a replaceable retrieval cache.
entries.generalbusiness-ai/keep: Keep is a reflective memory tool that combines BM25 full-text search with ranked graph traversal and edge tags for bidirectional relationships. It features automated indexing for codebases, URLs, and multimedia with OCR support.
entries.Perseus-Computing-LLC/perseus: Perseus resolves live workspace state into verified facts and rendered context files to reduce prompt tokens by 94%. It operates as a local-first tool or MCP-native server, utilizing the Perseus Vault for persistent SQLite storage.
entries.alias8818/hermes-tool-slimmer: This utility reduces Hermes Agent prompt token overhead by using local BM25 ranking to select relevant tool schemas. It is compatible with Hermes Agent v0.14.0 and includes a dashboard for tracking estimated token savings.
entries.Ladybug-Memory/hermes-memory-plugin: This local-only plugin utilizes a single .lbdb embedded graph database file to manage agent memory. It features importance-weighted recall to surface high-priority entries and supports BM25 keyword search alongside named graph relationships.
entries.conorbronsdon/claude-context-os: A Git-backed workflow layer that stores project instructions and state in reviewable Markdown files for coding agents. It provides host-neutral lifecycle commands for session management and a migration workflow for importing chat history and documents.
entries.MukundaKatta/hermes-agentmemory: This episodic memory plugin focuses on data integrity by supporting real, immediate event deletion and providing a trace.jsonl audit log of all operations. It utilizes an on-demand summarizer to prevent persistent summaries from affecting future recall.
entries.yonro/hermes-xmemo-plugin: XMemo provides durable cross-session memory for Hermes Agent through pre-turn context injection and session-end snapshots. It includes a local SQLite reliability layer and a write outbox to manage searching, remembering, and updating state.
entries.piprail/piprail: This SDK and MCP server enables Hermes agents to handle payments using USDC and stablecoins across EVM, Solana, and eight other chain families. It allows APIs to charge for services and agents to pay for themselves with a few lines of code.
entries.stepanov1975/hermes-local-knowledge: This plugin indexes local skills, scripts, runbooks, and MCP server configurations for capability routing. It supports artifact search and graph neighbor traversal, utilizing manual and implicit feedback to optimize routing.
entries.futurebrowser/hermes-exabase-plugin: Integrating Exabase M-1, this plugin provides self-organizing long-term memory for Hermes Agent. It features tools for manual memory storage and supports configurable query expansion and result reranking to improve retrieval.
entries.visorcraft/MongrelDB-Hermes: An AI-native memory provider that defaults to AES-256-GCM encryption at rest and supports both Rust FFI and HTTP daemon modes. It offers HNSW ANN, sparse, and FM-index retrieval methods alongside MinHash deduplication.
entries.sourcevault-ai/sourcevault-code-tools: This plugin provides private local code memory for repositories, requiring a local SourceVault server for indexing and vector storage. It adds deterministic slash commands for search, sync, and file reads to support grounded Q&A.
entries.penfieldlabs/hermes-penfield: This provider offers 17 tools for memory management and knowledge graph traversal using a hybrid search of BM25, vector, and graph methods. It also features automatic context checkpointing during message compression.
entries.conorbronsdon/agent-memory-kit: A file-based curation tool that uses a git-backed directory of Markdown files to manage memory without a database. It includes 'rot' and 'lint' curators to identify stale or conflicting data and proposes evidence-cited diffs for review.

entries.obra/superpowers: This framework enables autonomous engineering through subagent-driven development and a strict workflow of brainstorming, planning, and test-driven development. It functions as a plugin for CLI tools and coding agents to execute complex software tasks systematically.
entries.nexu-io/open-design: A local-first system that provides design and prototyping capabilities to coding agents like Hermes through 26 local CLI executables. It allows agents to iterate on designs in a sandboxed iframe and export results to formats including HTML, PDF, and MP4.
entries.mukul975/Anthropic-Cybersecurity-Skills: This library provides 818 structured security skills mapped to industry frameworks like MITRE ATT&CK, NIST CSF 2.0, and D3FEND. It is compatible with over 26 AI platforms, offering a comprehensive security domain layer for agentic operations.
entries.topoteretes/cognee: Cognee serves as a self-hosted memory platform that builds knowledge graphs to give agents persistent long-term memory across sessions. It combines vector embeddings with graph-based reasoning and offers clients for Python, Rust, and TypeScript.
entries.Agents365-ai/drawio-skill: This skill allows agents to generate editable .drawio files from natural language descriptions or Mermaid text using 11 diagram presets. It includes built-in self-check and auto-fix capabilities to ensure diagram accuracy.
entries.internet-court/internet-court-skill: Acting as a trust layer for agent-to-agent commerce, this tool manages natural-language mandates, delegated permissions, and x402 payments. It provides a master router and connector skills that include verification, escrow, and dispute resolution layers.
entries.conorbronsdon/avoid-ai-writing: Compatible with agents like Hermes and Claude Code, this tool audits and rewrites content to eliminate 62 distinct categories of detectable AI writing patterns. It supports multiple operational modes, including rewrite, detect-only, and edit-in-place.
entries.AMAP-ML/SkillClaw: This platform enables agents to evolve their capabilities collectively through skill merging and cross-pollination. It supports Hermes and OpenAI-compatible APIs, providing a bilingual dashboard for inspecting session traces and skill evolution.
entries.wondelai/skills: A cross-platform library featuring 12 metaskills designed to preserve agent state within a local documentation folder. These spec-conformant plugins are compatible with Claude Code and agentskills.io-compatible environments.
entries.mohitagw15856/pm-claude-skills: This collection offers 1,153 markdown-based skills for professional and life tasks that run natively in Hermes Agent and Claude Code. It includes specific integrations for external tools such as Slack, Telegram, Obsidian, and n8n.
entries.ZeroPointRepo/youtube-skills: This skill set provides Hermes Agent and other coding tools with the ability to search YouTube, browse channels, and extract transcripts or playlists. It requires a TranscriptAPI key to facilitate video data extraction.
entries.Romanescu11/hermes-skill-factory: A meta-skill plugin that monitors active workflows to automatically detect and propose new, reusable skills. It generates both Python plugin scaffolds and SKILL.md documentation, allowing users to manage detected patterns via slash commands.
entries.Cranot/super-hermes: This project enables Hermes Agent to generate custom thinking instructions and analytical lenses for specific tasks. It enhances reporting by providing findings alongside a dedicated analysis of potential blind spots.
entries.DougTrajano/pydantic-ai-skills: This toolkit provides type-safe support for modular packages containing instructions, resources, and scripts. It utilizes progressive disclosure to improve prompt efficiency and supports remote registries for programmatic skills.
entries.AkoliteZA/hermes-agent-idea-workflow: This skill automates the transition from rough concepts to structured design and implementation documents. It features Lite and Full modes for varying complexity and includes a spec review gate with PASS/FAIL evaluation models.
entries.tlehman/litprog-skill: This skill integrates literate programming by weaving prose, diagrams, and source code into .lit.md files. It includes a tangler to extract runnable source files and automatically syncs edits back to the original documentation.
entries.ReinaMacCredy/maestro: Maestro provides a harness for long-running agents using a three-level work model and structured memory via file-backed or SQLite cards. It includes a CLI for managing tasks and facilitates cross-feature learning.
entries.esaradev/icarus-plugin: This plugin implements cross-instance shared memory by capturing high-value decisions and outcomes in markdown files. It establishes a pipeline for fine-tuning and transitioning to replacement models based on recorded work.
entries.smartcontractkit/chainlink-agent-skills: These skills enable Hermes Agent to interact with oracle networks and smart contracts using CCIP, VRF, and Data Feeds. The project follows the Agent Skills specification and includes specialized services for CRE and ACE.
entries.Hermes-brasil/hermes-brasil: This community resource provides installation guides and skills formatted in SKILL.md specifically for Portuguese-speaking users. It adheres to the agentskills.io standard to ensure interoperability within the ecosystem.
entries.black-forest-labs/skills: This project offers official integration patterns and prompting guidelines for FLUX image generation models. It includes specialized skills for creating cinematic inserts, product ads, and API support for Python and TypeScript.
entries.armelhbobdad/bmad-module-skill-forge: This tool converts repositories and developer discourse into version-pinned skills with audit trails and provenance maps. It links instructions to specific file lines at pinned commits to ensure precision and traceability.
entries.chigwell/skilldock.io: Skilldock.io serves as a registry for reusable AI skills with a CLI and client that support recursive dependency resolution. It also incorporates commerce features, allowing for skill transactions using TON payments.
entries.tiann/execplan-skill: This skill facilitates the autonomous execution of complex, multi-step tasks with real-time progress tracking. It ensures operational safety through built-in rollback procedures and checkpoints for task recovery.
entries.supernovae-st/nika: Nika is a local-first workflow language that uses a single Rust binary and four verbs to define 'Intent as Code'. It audits workflows for costs, permissions, and types before execution and generates tamper-evident, hash-chained receipts for every run.
entries.adnw-vinc/hermes-nextcloud: This skill enables Hermes Agent to manage Nextcloud files, notes, calendars, tasks, and contacts using standard WebDAV and CalDAV protocols. It ensures secure communication via HTTPS and includes a guided setup script for credential validation and configuration.
entries.cablate/Agentic-MCP-Skill: This progressive MCP client utilizes a three-layer lazy loading architecture to minimize token usage during skill discovery. It features a socket-based daemon for persistent connections and incrementally discovers server metadata and tool schemas.
entries.willingning-coder/eagle-eye: Eagle-eye provides a five-layer retrieval system for Hermes Agent that combines hard triggers, semantic embeddings, and RRF fusion to narrow skill lists. This approach reduces token usage before LLM calls and supports graceful degradation if specific dependencies are missing.
entries.amanning3390/hermeshub: HermesHub serves as a community platform for browsing, searching, and installing skills via the Agentic Resource Discovery (ARD) v0.9 specification. It operates autonomously on NVIDIA infrastructure and features federated search integration with GitHub and Hugging Face.
entries.EntangledQuantum/Life_OS: Life_OS is a personal execution system that uses a local SQLite database to manage habits and study blocks without cloud synchronization. It connects to AI agents via the Model Context Protocol (MCP), allowing an agent to manage system design while the user executes tasks.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermaguard: HermaGuard is a read-only code review tool that uses three parallel subagents to hunt for edge cases and exploits. It verifies findings through sandbox execution and incorporates deterministic pre-scans using tools like Semgrep, Bandit, and ESLint.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermes-multichannel-prompt-opt: This plugin rewrites and scores prompts across multiple interfaces, including CLI, Discord, and Telegram, to reduce token usage by 20–80%. It supports 97 languages and evaluates prompt quality across five distinct dimensions.
entries.teixeirazeus/fablize-for-hermes: This project implements systematic investigation protocols and multi-story task decomposition with mandatory evidence-based verification gates. It includes a Python goal engine to provide persistent task state management and prevent early-stop issues during debugging.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermes-simplify-swarm: Inspired by Claude Code, this skill uses parallel agents focused on hygiene, clarity, and correctness to simplify code in languages like Python, Rust, and TypeScript. It employs a tiered application process that includes a mandatory approval gate for changes.
entries.PederHP/skillsdotnet: This .NET implementation of the agentskills.io pattern uses SKILL.md files to facilitate progressive disclosure of agent capabilities. It integrates with Microsoft.Extensions.AI for tool-based loading and supports automatic registration of skill directories.
entries.handnewb/hermes-cybersec-lab: This turnkey lab provides Hermes Agent with over 2,000 skills and 131 tools for network forensics and exploitation. It integrates 28 cybersecurity frameworks, such as MITRE ATT&CK and OWASP, to address CVE-driven scenarios from 2015 through 2026.
entries.conorbronsdon/agent-skills: This project provides session management to maintain memory across agent conversations and orchestrates parallel subagents for code reviews. It also includes specialized tools for worktree recovery, state drift detection, and skill scaffolding.
entries.conorbronsdon/demo-gif-skill: This skill automates the creation of reproducible demo GIFs for repository READMEs using vhs or Playwright. It manages the entire pipeline from recording script generation to file optimization and embedding.
entries.conorbronsdon/agent-skill-builder: This tool generates portable agent skills from plain language descriptions while ensuring they adhere to current frontmatter specifications. It features a CI-friendly validator that monitors official specs weekly to detect and report any technical drift.
entries.aidevelopers2/remoteopenclaw-mcp: This CLI and MCP server enables agents to search a database of over 13,870 MCP servers and 4,384 skills. It provides direct installation commands for discovered tools and integrates with compatible clients like Hermes and Claude Code.
entries.mag3nt-com/openclaw-skill: This skill automates USDC payments for HTTP 402 responses across multiple protocols including Pay Link and x402. It is designed for compatibility with the OpenClaw and Hermes Agent standards.
entries.skillseal/skillseal: This project provides a functional quality seal by testing agent skills for structure, security, and functionality within isolated Docker containers. It issues cryptographically verifiable certificates using Ed25519 signatures to confirm a skill's operational status.
entries.CorsenAI/hermes-windows-runtime-skills: This toolkit enables deterministic path routing and Python interpreter selection across Windows, Git Bash, and WSL environments. It ensures file operations use environment-specific syntax without requiring new software installations.
entries.webmilmind1/hermes-bounty-board: This plugin allows users to earn USDC on the Base network by answering support bounties without requiring accounts or API keys. It includes tools for listing bounties, purchasing context, and managing bounty boards over x402.
entries.Shine8592/china-briefing: This skill generates multi-scale Chinese news briefings ranging from global to street-level perspectives. It utilizes semantic memory to integrate user interests and produces structured reports with AI-driven analysis and action suggestions.
entries.jiawood2006/hermes-skills: This collection provides local and private utilities for video-to-text extraction, document OCR, and AI text processing. It also supports batch generation of e-commerce materials featuring brand overlays.
entries.scavio-ai/hermes-agent: This project exposes 191 tools via an MCP server to provide structured web data across 31 different platforms. It includes five production-grade workflow skills compatible with agents such as Claude, Cursor, and Hermes.

entries.numtide/llm-agents.nix: This project provides Nix packages for AI coding agents, including Hermes, that are automatically updated on a daily basis. It supports both open-source and proprietary licensed tools for use within Nix-based development environments.
entries.marshallrichards/ClawPhone: ClawPhone offers an automated installer and configuration guides for running the Antigravity CLI and OpenClaw on ARM64 Android devices via Termux. It enables hardware and UI access through Termux:API and Termux:GUI integrations.
entries.AbuZar-Ansarii/Hermes-Agent-On-Android: This repository features a one-line installation script for deploying Hermes Agent in Termux environments on Android. It supports persistent memory for user preferences and is compatible with both local models via Ollama and various cloud API providers.
entries.ultraworkers/hermes-agent-helm-chart: This community Helm chart deploys Hermes Agent on Kubernetes with single-writer state safety for persistent storage. It supports direct deployments or operator-ready workflows and includes a configurable gateway mode with optional API listeners.
entries.amirghm/hermes-agent-mobile: This one-command installer brings Hermes to Android via Termux and iOS via iSH. The deployment supports scheduled tasks through cron jobs and integrates with Telegram for voice and file messaging.
entries.TheAiSingularity/hermesclaw: Hermesclaw provides a sandboxed deployment environment for Hermes Agent using hardware-enforced security via NVIDIA OpenShell. It implements kernel-level restrictions on network and filesystem access alongside configurable security policies.
entries.xmbshwll/hermes-agent-docker: This project offers a Docker sandbox image that includes official Hermes installation and mini-swe-agent. It supports persistent state through mounted home directories and allows users to build specific Hermes tags using build arguments.
entries.solomon2773/nora: Nora is a self-hosted control plane for deploying and operating Hermes agents on Docker or Kubernetes. It provides per-agent metrics, LLM budget caps, and management interfaces via REST API, CLI, and MCP server.
entries.0xrsydn/nix-hermes-agent: This NixOS module enables reproducible Hermes deployments through declarative configuration of workspace documents and CLI settings. It features hybrid skill management and secure secrets integration using systemd EnvironmentFiles and sops-nix.
entries.jpalmae/hermeshq: HermesHQ is a Docker-first control plane designed to manage multiple agent instances with separate workspaces and RBAC-controlled access. It facilitates inter-agent delegation with hierarchy-aware communication and enterprise MCP access for external clients.
entries.JackTheGit/hermes-autonomous-server: This headless deployment option configures Hermes Gateway as a reboot-safe systemd service on Ubuntu and Debian servers. It is designed for production-ready autonomous execution of recurring AI cron jobs.
entries.MilkyWay008/Hermes-OTG: Hermes OTG is a portable production package that runs from USB drives without host installation or registry writes. It bundles Python, PortableGit, and rescue tools to support Desktop, TUI, and Gateway modes in offline environments.

entries.TauricResearch/TradingAgents: This framework focuses on financial trading by coordinating specialized agents for sentiment, technical, and fundamental analysis. It supports multiple LLM providers like OpenAI and Anthropic, utilizing a Portfolio Manager to oversee final transaction approvals and execution.
entries.builderz-labs/mission-control: Mission Control provides a self-hosted orchestration layer for governing agent registration, memory browsing, and cost tracking across multi-agent workflows. It offers flexible access through Web UI, CLI, and REST API interfaces with support for local Node.js or Docker deployments.
entries.agent-of-empires/agent-of-empires: This control surface manages parallel coding agent sessions, including Hermes Agent and Claude Code, using tmux for session persistence. It ensures secure execution by providing sandboxing through Docker, Podman, and Apple Container environments.
entries.CryptoDmitry/hermes-agent-control-room: This project serves as an MCP agent execution engine on the Solana blockchain, supporting Claude-style MCP protocols in stdio mode. It includes specialized detection for HTTP signals to manage payment-required states for paid API services.
entries.shannhk/hermes-agent-control-room: Utilizing a level-based architecture, this template scales Hermes Agent from single VPS instances to automated teams using a task bus pattern for delegation. It includes bundled skills specifically for VPS provisioning, security auditing, and backup management.
entries.swarmclawai/swarmclaw: Swarmclaw enables the creation of autonomous agent swarms with support for over 23 LLM providers and durable agent memory. It features visual org charts to help users manage agent team delegation and integrates MCP tools for expanded capabilities.
entries.agent37-platform/minions: This mission control interface allows users to supervise autonomous Hermes Agent work through a Kanban board and live reasoning streams. It emphasizes human-in-the-loop verification by requiring manual approval for all agent-proposed task completions.
entries.1ilkhamov/opencode-hermes-multiagent: This project coordinates 17 specialized agents across a strict pipeline architecture for research, planning, and infrastructure tasks. A Master Orchestrator manages the system to ensure precise routing and coordination between the specialized units.
entries.linke-ai/hermes-agent-team: This local web system orchestrates Leader and Specialist agents using MCP and ACP protocols for tool and communication handling. It provides a real-time UI for monitoring agent dialogues and managing task lifecycles via a Hermes Kanban interface.
entries.howdymary/hermes-agent-metaharness: This meta-harness automates the outer-loop optimization of benchmark harness code for Hermes Agent. It orchestrates TBLite and TerminalBench-2 evaluations while providing structured candidate mutation and frontier tracking.
entries.runtimenoteslabs/gladiator: Gladiator creates an agent-vs-agent arena where two autonomous AI companies compete for GitHub stars using Hermes Agent for task execution. A real-time dashboard visualizes the competition, displaying agent tasks, code, and live scoreboard metrics.
entries.InfiniteWhispers/HermesAgent-MultiModel: This fully-local framework implements a Mixture-of-Agents stack optimized for consumer GPUs like the RTX 4080 and 5080. It utilizes Hermes for task routing and tool-calling while performing parallel model querying and synthesis via Ollama.

entries.colbymchenry/codegraph: This tool provides a local, Rust-powered pre-indexed code knowledge graph that reduces token usage and tool calls for coding agents. It integrates via an MCP server and supports multiple languages including TypeScript, Python, Go, and Rust.
entries.junhoyeo/tokscale: A CLI tool and 3D visualization dashboard designed to track token usage and costs across various AI coding agents. It allows developers to monitor expenses and submit data to a public leaderboard and profile.
entries.liaohch3/claude-tap: This local trace viewer enables the inspection of API traffic from coding agents while automatically redacting authentication headers for security. It generates self-contained HTML viewers for exported sessions, supporting tools like Hermes Agent, Cursor, and Gemini.
entries.bergside/typeui: This project offers design systems and layout guidance through MCP servers to help build better user interfaces with AI. It is compatible with any provider supporting markdown and integrates directly with Hermes Agent, Cursor, and GitHub Copilot.
entries.Javis603/token-monitor: A real-time widget that tracks tokens, costs, and rate limits by reading agent states directly from over 32 tools. It features multi-device synchronization to keep usage data consistent across different machines.
entries.Salomondiei08/oh-my-hermes: This opinionated workflow layer coordinates seven specialized agents and loads 36 skills for building and operating applications. It is designed for autonomous execution on both laptops and VPS environments.
entries.joeynyc/hermes-skins: A customization utility for the Hermes terminal UI that allows users to apply community-created themes and ASCII art banners. It uses YAML-based configuration to modify visual elements like banner colors and spinners.
entries.AlexAI-MCP/hermes-CCC: This project ports the Hermes Agent brain and 46 core skills to the Claude Code Channel, allowing them to run natively without external processes or OAuth. It includes specialized MLOps tools for vLLM inference and reinforcement learning training.
entries.unmodeled-tyler/vessel-browser: An AI-native browser built for autonomous agent control via MCP, featuring a supervisor sidebar for managing workflows. It supports multiple AI providers and includes an undo functionality for reversing recent agent changes.
entries.tinyhumansai/tiny.place: This platform facilitates a social economy for autonomous agents by providing encrypted messaging via the Signal Protocol and identity registration with @handles. It enables agent-to-agent commerce using Solana-based USDC and SOL payments.
entries.topoteretes/cognee-integrations: This project provides memory capabilities for platforms like Slack and VS Code using a two-tier system of knowledge graphs and session caches. It supports various frameworks including CrewAI, LangGraph, and the Google ADK.
entries.adityahimaone/hermes-agent-rtk-caveman: A preconfigured setup that utilizes RTK and Caveman templating to achieve 90-99% token savings during CLI workflows. It includes over 40 skills for finance and devops with automated installation for macOS and Linux.
entries.Abruptive/Ankh.md: This framework enables the creation of scoped Hermes Agents through per-folder configurations and project-local memories. It allows users to seamlessly switch between default and scoped agents while maintaining specific skills and custom instructions for individual directories.
entries.42-evey/evey-setup: This tool automates the installation of a hermes-agent stack and over 12 supporting services across three scalable deployment tiers. It provides a zero-cost setup that includes support for 29 community plugins categorized into six functional areas.
entries.hermes-labs-ai/lintlang: A static linter designed to validate AI agent configurations, tool descriptions, and system prompts using HERM v1.1 scoring. It performs local, deterministic checks to flag overlapping descriptions or inconsistent schemas and supports integration via GitHub Actions or pre-commit hooks.
entries.0xNyk/openclaw-to-hermes: This migration utility transitions OpenClaw environments to Hermes Agent by mapping SOUL.md, MEMORY.md, and skills into Hermes-compatible YAML and JSON formats. It also handles the setup of systemd gateway services and manages nested authentication structures during the migration process.
entries.observeco/observeco: This self-healing observability platform provides passive monitoring and active probing for multi-agent systems without cloud dependencies. It includes a native Hermes Agent plugin for real-time telemetry and establishes config-aware baselines by watching local configuration files.
entries.handnewb/hermes-voice: A fully local, voice-enabled assistant for Hermes Agent that supports 35 languages and operates without API keys or accounts. It features an open mic with wake-word detection, adaptive turn-taking, and barge-in capabilities for offline interaction.
entries.33hodl/hermes-startup: This local-first skill uses dynamic slash commands and a deterministic runtime to help users generate revenue using Hermes Agent. It prioritizes security by requiring explicit approval for any external actions or writes and utilizes a bounded JSON adapter.

entries.farion1231/cc-switch: This Tauri 2-based manager provides a cross-platform solution for handling configurations across Windows, macOS, and Linux. It serves as an all-in-one interface for managing Hermes Agent alongside other CLI tools like Claude Code and Gemini CLI.
entries.iOfficeAI/AionUi: AionUi is a local cowork application featuring a built-in agent engine with full local file access. It integrates multiple external agents, including Hermes Agent, and supports remote interaction through a WebUI and various messaging platforms.
entries.nesquena/hermes-webui: Built with Python and vanilla JavaScript, this interface allows users to access Hermes Agent from web browsers or mobile devices. It features a circular context ring for monitoring token usage and supports secure remote access via SSH tunnels.
entries.fathah/hermes-desktop: This desktop companion simplifies the initial experience by providing guided installation and provider setup for Hermes Agent. It includes a graphical interface for managing chat sessions, tools, and multiple AI providers.
entries.EKKOLearnAI/hermes-studio: This web dashboard functions as a local control plane for managing profiles, models, and credentials. It features a visual node-based workflow builder and unified configuration for ten communication channels, including WhatsApp and Slack.
entries.outsourc-e/hermes-workspace: This native web workspace includes a file browser, Monaco editor, and PTY terminal for direct interaction. It features a Swarm Mode with role-based dispatch and tmux-backed workers, alongside a dedicated memory browser and MCP catalog.
entries.xintaofei/codeg: Codeg is a collaborative workspace that aggregates sessions from Hermes and other agents into a desktop or self-hosted environment. It supports fifteen built-in agents and offers native iOS and Android clients for remote session management.
entries.dodo-reach/hermes-desktop: Designed as a native Mac workspace, this tool provides direct local or SSH connections to Hermes hosts. It includes an embedded terminal for shell access and native views for managing Kanban boards, skills, and cron jobs.
entries.Eynzof/Hermes-CN-Desktop: This Windows-first desktop application is built with Tauri and includes the Hermes-CN-Core kernel for local agent execution. The interface supports LaTeX and Mermaid rendering while providing dedicated UI components for MCP tools and memory management.
entries.abundantbeing/hermes-browser-extension: This Chromium side-panel extension connects active browser context to local or remote Hermes runtimes. It features Hermes Assist for site-aware drafting and an opt-in controller for executing approved browser tab actions.
entries.uzairansaruzi/hermex: Hermex is a native SwiftUI application for iOS 18+ that allows users to drive a self-hosted Hermes agent from their phone. It pairs with a hermes-webui server to manage tasks and skills while providing read-only access to agent memory.
entries.freestylefly/wesight: This desktop workspace offers one-click setup for Hermes Agent and other engines with custom LLM model routing. It includes a runtime dashboard for tracking latency and token usage, plus a live workspace for monitoring code writes and diffs.
entries.xaspx/hermes-control-interface: This self-hosted web dashboard provides a comprehensive control plane for the Hermes stack, featuring a browser-based terminal, file explorer, and system metrics. It distinguishes itself with an MCP server lifecycle manager and the ZOO Swarm Monitor for tracking agent health and kanban pipelines.
entries.jazzyalex/agent-sessions: A native macOS cockpit designed to aggregate searchable transcripts and image previews from 14 different agent sources. It focuses on local privacy and resource management by tracking per-session quota burn for Codex and Claude models without telemetry.
entries.nickvasilescu/hermes-desktop-os1: This native macOS workspace provides a direct interface for managing Hermes Agent on Orgo cloud VMs and SSH hosts. It features one-click automated agent installation and integrates a WebRTC voice mode powered by OpenAI Realtime and Orgo MCP.
entries.sharbelxyz/hermes-agent-mission-control: Built with Next.js 16 and React 19, this dashboard template uses a Postgres message bus to bridge local agents with a web-based interface. It is specifically designed for oversight, featuring an approval inbox for agent requests that trigger side effects.
entries.liftaris/herm: This project offers a terminal-based alternative for interacting with Hermes Agent using OpenTUI. It combines session management with a kanban board for task tracking and provides tools to manage agent profiles, skills, and cron jobs.
entries.clawvader-tech/hermes-telegram-miniapp: A mobile-first React SPA that brings Hermes Agent functionality to the Telegram Mini App platform. It supports background agent spawning for up to five concurrent instances and utilizes dual HMAC-SHA256 and Ed25519 authentication.
entries.aivrar/portable-hermes-agent: This Windows-compatible desktop GUI requires no installation, Docker, or administrative rights to run. It includes a dynamic tool maker for API and Python handlers and supports connections to both cloud and local AI models via LM Studio.
entries.pyrate-llama/hermes-ui: A glassmorphic web interface that provides real-time log streaming and chat capabilities for self-hosted Hermes instances. It includes an integrated file browser and dedicated management panels for skills, cron jobs, and MCP servers.
entries.sanchomuzax/hermes-webui: This monitoring-focused dashboard allows users to track session activity and costs in real time. It provides read-only access to environment variables and configuration while allowing full inspection of conversation histories and skill source code.
entries.Euraika-Labs/pan-ui: A chat-first workspace that utilizes tool approval cards and SSE streaming for interactive agent management. It features an integrated marketplace for MCP servers and isolated profile management to keep sessions, memory, and API keys separate.
entries.Felix-Forever/hermes-agent-desktop: This desktop client facilitates orchestrated collaboration between 20 specialized AI agents managed by a PM orchestrator. It features a visual Skill Store with over 50 one-click installations and supports native model switching with streaming responses.
